      (∀ V ∈ nhds 0,
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,

                  (BfgsVerification.LNormalizedReturn.pointLift v) =

                    4 =

  (h : Option ℝ) (a : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel l h a =
    match fuel with
    | 0 => (none, [])
    | fuel.succ =>
      if BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.Armijo F x p g c₁ a then
        if BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.Wolfe F x p g c₂ a then (some a, [a])

              (BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.nextTrial a h);
          (r.1, a :: r.2)

        let r :=
          BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel l (some a)
            (BfgsVerification.DeterministicLineSearch.nextTrial l (some a));
        (r.1, a :: r.2)

  (h : Option ℝ) (a : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel l h a =
    match fuel with
    | 0 => (none, [])
    | fuel.succ =>
      if BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.Armijo F x p g c₁ a then
        if BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.Wolfe F x p g c₂ a then (some a, [a])
        else
          let r :=
            BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel a h
              (BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.nextTrial a h);
          (r.1, a :: r.2)
      else
        let r :=
          BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.search F x p g c₁ c₂ fuel l (some a)
            (BfgsVerification.NonStrictLineSearch.nextTrial l (some a));
        (r.1, a :: r.2)
